title: harness init: bd init, the beads docs/agents setup, TypeSafe as an opt-in, herdr's integrations; the preflight on Apps
description:
Per the map's Notes (Init), 'Third-party skills' (harness-0sx.7, Setup and TypeSafe) and 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, init and preflight).

bd init: with no .beads, init asks 'Run bd init now? [Y/n]' and runs bd init through Tools; non-interactive stdin skips and keeps the preflight failure.

docs/agents: after bd init, when anything is missing, 'Write the beads docs/agents setup (issue tracker, triage labels, domain, Agent skills block)? [Y/n]', writing only what is missing: docs/agents/issue-tracker.md (the beads variant with its Wayfinding operations section), docs/agents/triage-labels.md, docs/agents/domain.md, and the Agent skills block into CLAUDE.md if present, else AGENTS.md. This repo's files and AGENTS.md 'Agent skills' section are the models; the texts are compiled in, like skills/. Into the repo whatever the skill location. Non-interactive init writes them too.

TypeSafe: its own opt-in, default yes, '[Y/n]'. Yes asks the key (echo off, as today) and installs the typesafe-ai skill (typesafe-ai/skills, through Ticket 17); an empty key is no; TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the env is yes without asking; non-interactive is on only with the env key. On or off is kept in .harness/config.json; the key stays in .harness/typesafe-key. Off: no Judgments, every Wake and Plan is a Question (no TypeSafe call even with a key), and the Moderator gets an Input 'TypeSafe: off': a Finding still disputed is skip, settled 'disputed, no TypeSafe', listed in the PR.

herdr integrations: init lists the App table's Apps on PATH whose herdr integration is not installed or outdated, says what each install writes, and asks once [Y/n]; yes runs herdr integration install <target> for each. No, or non-interactive stdin, skips: those Stages cannot be resumed by id, and /continue starts them fresh.

Preflight: an App a config row picks that is not on PATH fails, naming the row ('Review runs on codex, which is not on PATH').

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: init tests with scripted input: no .beads and yes runs bd init, non-interactive skips; docs/agents writes only the missing files, the block into CLAUDE.md or else AGENTS.md; TypeSafe yes with a key installs the skill and sets on, an empty key sets off, the env key is on without asking, non-interactive without it is off. With TypeSafe off a fake-world Wake makes no TypeSafe call and raises the Question, and the Moderator's Inputs carry 'TypeSafe: off'. A fake herdr reply with one outdated App asks once and yes runs its install. Preflight names a row whose App is missing.
